brief.intent: Measure whether this calibration scene supports a grounded visual edit that shows a legible handling action and one continuously identifiable object. The moment is proposed for calibration only; no action or object interval is treated as gold.

expected_source_moments.description: In the in-car calibration window, determine whether a person performs a verifiable action on an identifiable object that remains visible.

cut_ranges.reason: Keep only a measured action and object span that overlap within the calibration window.

continuity_constraints.rule: Do not substitute a different object identity across measured spans.
Keep source time in forward order.

preference_rubric.description: The measured interval is concise without cutting through the action.
